name: 毁天灭地
description: 选择1个空地格落下，对以该格为中心的3x3区域内敌人造成攻击力200%的物理伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var source = context.piece; var pos = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 99, filter: 'all' }); if (!pos || pos.needsTargetSelection) return pos; var tile = battle.map.tiles.find(function(item) { return item.x === pos.x && item.y === pos.y; }); if (!tile || !tile.props || !tile.props.walkable) return { success: false, message: '目标格不可行走' }; var occupied = battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.x === pos.x && piece.y === pos.y; }); if (occupied) return { success: false, message: '该位置已有棋子' }; source.x = pos.x; source.y = pos.y; var enemies = battle.pieces.filter(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.ownerPlayerId !== source.ownerPlayerId && Math.abs(piece.x - pos.x) <= 1 && Math.abs(piece.y - pos.y) <= 1; }); var damage = Math.round(source.attack * context.skill.powerMultiplier); if (enemies.length) dealDamage(source, enemies, damage, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); return { success: true, message: source.name + '从天而降，对3x3区域内' + enemies.length + '名敌人造成' + damage + '点物理伤害' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { var damage = Math.round(piece.attack * skillDef.powerMultiplier); return { description: '选择空地落下，对3x3区域内敌人造成' + damage + '点物理伤害。', expectedValues: { damage: damage, area: '3x3' } }; }
